an4.36:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā antarā ca ukkaṭṭhaṃ antarā ca setavyaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.36:1.2: doṇopi sudaṃ brāhmaṇo antarā ca ukkaṭṭhaṃ antarā ca setavyaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.36:1.3: addasā kho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavato pādesu cakkāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāni.
an4.36:1.7: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an4.36:1.8: atha kho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavato pādāni anugacchanto addasa bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamadamathasamathamanuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ saṃyatindriyaṃ nāgaṃ.
an4.36:1.9: disvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an4.36:2.2: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, devo bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.4: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, gandhabbo bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.6: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, yakkho bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.8: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, manusso bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:3.1: devo no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.2: ‘na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, devo bhavissāmī’ti vadesi.
an4.36:3.3: gandhabbo no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.4: ‘na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, gandhabbo bhavissāmī’ti vadesi.
an4.36:3.5: yakkho no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.6: ‘na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, yakkho bhavissāmī’ti vadesi.
an4.36:3.7: manusso no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.8: ‘na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, manusso bhavissāmī’ti vadesi.
an4.36:4.1: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, āsavānaṃ appahīṇattā devo bhaveyyaṃ, te me āsavā pahīṇā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an4.36:4.2: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, āsavānaṃ appahīṇattā gandhabbo bhaveyyaṃ …pe… yakkho bhaveyyaṃ …pe… manusso bhaveyyaṃ, te me āsavā pahīṇā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an4.36:4.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakaṃ accuggamma ṭhāti anupalittaṃ udakena.
an4.36:4.4: evameva kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, loke jāto loke saṃvaḍḍho lokaṃ abhibhuyya viharāmi anupalitto lokena.
